name: Posthorn Self-Hosted Email Gateway
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted outbound email gateway with HTTP form, HTTP API and SMTP ingress and configurable outbound transports; no software subscription or vendor-imposed gateway quota.
watch_out: Does not provide free email delivery or sending credits. Requires a separately configured transactional email provider or SMTP relay, which may charge fees or enforce quotas, plus your own Docker/server resources. Delivery limits and commercial terms of the upstream provider are separate.
